text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On this day as well, Sweep Tosho tackled the summer camp menu with everything she had.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiaaar, juice please...!
choice_data_list: I've got it ready in the fridge.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Just getting it ready isn't enough!
Bring it all the way over to me properly!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
My legs are completely worn out now...
Phew...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Just when I thought I finally cast the ultimate spell.
Why do boring pests always have to show up afterwards?
choice_data_list: Will you get sick of it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course!
I haaaate it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Still, having it end like this is even worse!
I'm gonna use my magic
to blast all these boring things to cinders!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're covered in mud today too, Sweep-san.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy, you too, right?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes. Because the Tenno Sho (Autumn) will be my revenge match.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "...I have no intention of writing 'The End' to my story just yet."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, I appreciate you being so quick on the uptake.
Magic needs that kind of fiery ambition, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there! If you stop dead in your tracks,
you're gonna cause a pileup behind you, whoops!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ! Teio-san!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe, were you thinking about something?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Like—
the Tenno Sho (Autumn), for instance!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh!? How did you know about that...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I totally know what you mean~!
I mean, Sweep's voice was super loud when she declared it to you in the plaza!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Besides, when it comes to the girl you're cheering for...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No matter what it takes to spark it, I want her
to stand back up again! That's what I believe too!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...! ...I'm sorry...
Even though Teio-san has been cheering for me since the Hanshin JF...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, hold on~! That doesn't count, no way!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Don't say 'used to support you'—I'm *still* supporting you right now!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So please, let me wish upon the shooting star...
—that you'll be able to run again!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Teio-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beneath a summer sky full of stars,
the Umamusume share their respective hopes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the seasons march on into autumn—!
